clues: This city in the heart of Ukraine stands on the banks of the Dnieper. It serves as the chief town of its district and area.
The rain here peaks in June, then drops to its low in January. That swing marks the year, from warm wet summers to cold dry winters.
This town is thought to have been founded in 1571. A fort was first set up here after a great union pact was signed.
This city was burned down in a siege in 1663. It rose again and for a short time served as chief town of a wide new land.
The town's Stone Tower was built in the late 1700s. It stands out as one of its best known old sights and marks.
